newsitem.title: USA: Mercury General to buy American Fidelity.
newsitem.headline: Mercury General to buy American Fidelity.

text.p: Mercury General Corp said on Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to buy the American Fidelity Insurance Company (AFI) for $34.8 million in cash.
The price approximates AFI's surplus at December 31, 1995, based on statutory insurance accounting, the company said.
Mercury intends to fund the purchase with borrowings under an enlarged term loan facility.
The company's total written premium volume in 1995 was $90 million, of which about 47 percent was in the automobile lines.
